catalog_scope: Selected AI, machine learning, NLP, computer vision, data mining, and general AI conferences.
deadline_policy: Deadlines are deliberately not stored. Users must verify the current call for papers on the official site.

conferences.name: International Conference on Learning Representations
conferences.scope: Representation learning and deep learning, including optimization, reinforcement learning, vision, speech, natural language processing, robotics, and related applications.
conferences.notes: Broad deep-learning scope; verify the current call for papers.

conferences.name: International Conference on Machine Learning
conferences.scope: Research in machine learning, including theory, algorithms, systems, applications, evaluation, and responsible machine learning.
conferences.notes: General machine-learning venue; verify track-level scope.

conferences.name: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
conferences.scope: Machine learning and computational neuroscience, including foundations, algorithms, systems, datasets, evaluation, and interdisciplinary applications.
conferences.notes: Broad venue; recommendation is topical fit only.

conferences.name: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
conferences.scope: Computational linguistics and natural language processing, including language modeling, machine translation, information extraction, dialogue, generation, evaluation, ethics, and linguistic analysis.
conferences.notes: Use for work whose primary contribution is in NLP or computational linguistics.

conferences.name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
conferences.scope: Empirical methods for natural language processing, including language models, evaluation, datasets, generation, understanding, information extraction, and multilingual NLP.
conferences.notes: Verify the current EMNLP event page through the ACL portal.

conferences.name: Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
conferences.scope: Computer vision and pattern recognition, including image and video understanding, recognition, detection, segmentation, 3D vision, vision-language learning, and visual generation.
conferences.notes: Primary contribution should be in computer vision or pattern recognition.

conferences.name: ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
conferences.scope: Knowledge discovery and data mining, including scalable data systems, graph mining, recommender systems, applied data science, responsible data mining, and industrial applications.

conferences.name: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
conferences.scope: Broad artificial intelligence research, including knowledge representation, reasoning, planning, search, machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, agents, and AI applications.
conferences.notes: Broad AI scope; verify the current technical track.
